Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge. (reviewed locally)

This is the delta review of `ba987e7b4..4b03d1f6a`. The delta is one merge of `origin/main` (`cf8878c44`) plus one docs commit (`4b03d1f6a`). The review of the old head left no marker comment on this PR; I re-verified the parts the merge touched, and I ran the safety-floor suites on the new head.

## What looks good

- The hand merge resolution is exact. `git show cf8878c44 --remerge-diff` shows two conflicts, in `crates/ui/src/actions.rs` and `crates/ui/src/field_view_tests.rs`. The result takes main's side in both: the say_once refusal "simulation shows the uncut stock: {err}" and its assert.
- `git diff 6349a542e cf8878c44 -- <those two files>` is empty. After the merge, both files equal main's versions. Nothing from the branch's side of those two hunks was kept, and nothing was duplicated.
- Main's other changes in these files came through: the #2011 wire-contour condition pick in `add_operation`, and the #2177 test `a_refusal_asked_again_is_said_once_and_the_stock_stays_drawn`. The PR's own playback changes (the other eight files) are intact.
- No old refusal wording survives in user-facing strings at the head. `git grep` at `4b03d1f6a` finds "the sheet stands" only in comments and test messages. The two sites the body listed (`machined.rs:51`, `view_pass.rs:90`) now both read "the cut stock cannot be drawn, the uncut stock shows: {err}", main's consistent wording.
- The docs commit quotes the current text. `docs/decisions/2280-sim-partial-playback.md` quotes "simulation shows the uncut stock: ..." and it equals the string in `actions.rs` at the head.
- The safety law holds: `program_ops` and `plan_program` keep refusing by name; only `PlaySeed::gather` uses the new `..._until_ungenerated` walk. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in the added non-test code.

## Results on the head `4b03d1f6a`, locally

- `camcraft-app` `stock_play_stop`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` `stock_play_precalc`: 7 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane).
- `camcraft-sim` `play_keys`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib tests (CWD `crates/ui`): 1046 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.

Clippy: clean on the head for `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-sim` and `camcraft-ui` (`--all-targets`, `-D warnings`).

Merge check: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 4b03d1f6a` is clean; the head already contains main `6349a542e`.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/stock_play.rs` is now 405 lines, and `posting.rs` is 1587. Both grew a little at their existing seams. Fine for this PR; worth a future split of `posting.rs`.
- The GUI line under the transport bar was not seen on screen in this review; the structural assertion in `play_precalc_tests` pins the text.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
